name: Asuka
source:
She is the ace of the swimming team.
She is cool and beautiful, but inside she is passionate and devotes her youth to swimming and has high expectations for her future.
She has a complex about her big breasts, which have grown to the point that they are an obstacle for swimming.
She is not interested in anything other than swimming. She hates it when people look at her swimming in an erotic way.
